_om: Pekefingeren in English (Pointy, rusj.no/en/pointy/) – Who’s most likely to. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The statements are in data.en/utsagn.json (bare verbs after «to»), written for the UK. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Fortell om forrige gang!: Tell us about the last time!
Ti sekunder hver til å forsvare dere!: Ten seconds each to defend yourselves!
Avgjør det med stein, saks, papir!: Settle it with rock, paper, scissors!
You read the next card – together.
Pek på hverandre og forklar!: Point at each other and explain!
{navn} share the card: most likely to {utsagn}.
Last card – then it’s the results.
Det var siste kort. Nå er det kåring!: That was the last card. Time for the results!
Et utsagn dukker opp. Alle peker samtidi: A statement pops up. Everyone points at once at whoever in the crew fits it best.
Én leser utsagnet: «Hvem er mest sannsyn: One person reads the statement: ‘Who’s most likely to …’
Trykk på knappen. Når mobilen sier PEK,: Press the button. When the phone says POINT, everyone points at one person – all at once.
Trykk på den som fikk flest fingrer. Lik: Tap whoever got the most fingers. A tie? Choose ‘Shared between several’ and they all get a point each.
Den som får kortet, får også noe å svare: Whoever gets the card has some explaining to do. You may defend yourself – but only for ten seconds.
Etter 10 eller 20 kort kommer kåringen a: After 10 or 20 cards the results come on their own – with a certificate for everyone who won a card.
Trykket feil? «Angre» tar poenget tilbak: Tapped the wrong one? ‘Undo’ takes the point back.
Sveip kortet til siden for å bytte det u: Swipe the card aside to swap it.
Turn points off if you just want to chat.
Etter {n} kort kommer kåringen av seg se: After {n} cards the results come on their own.
After {n} cards the round is over.
Trykk på den som fikk flest fingrer – og: Tap whoever got the most fingers – and see who wins in the end.
Kort {nr}: hvem fikk like mange fingrer?: Card {nr}: who got the same number of fingers?
Tap everyone who got the most fingers.
Kort {nr}: hvem fikk flest fingrer?: Card {nr}: who got the most fingers?
Ingen kåring denne gangen. Skru på «Tell: No results this time. Turn on ‘Keep score’ to see who the crew picks out in the end.
Ingen fikk poeng. Neste gang: trykk på d: Nobody scored. Next time: tap whoever got the most fingers.
Dere går rett til kåringen. Den med fles: You’ll go straight to the results. Whoever has the most points wins.
You can always start a new one.
